name: Hungry Fog — Additional Material (d20pfsrd)
body:
More on Hungry Fog from d20pfsrd.com.

These sections appear on d20pfsrd.com's page "Hungry Cloud" but are not part of the Hungry Fog entry, which is unchanged.

HUNGRY CLOUD
CR 6

An immense green cloud boils forward, the fleeting images of corpses and decay implied with every bizarre eddy.

XP 2,400
N Colossal ooze
Init -3; Senses Perception -5
Aura bewitching brume (10 ft., DC 8)

DEFENSE

AC –1, touch –1, flat-footed –1 (–3 Dex, –8 size)
hp 59 (7d8+28)

ECOLOGY

Environment any temperate
Organization solitary, pair, or bank (3-10)
Treasure none

Hungry clouds form at the confluence of many hungry fogs. These sentient mists are infused with negative energy, and drawn to areas of negative energy often visited by the living (such as graveyards). Hungry clouds have been seen floating across oceans near great battles or shipwrecks. However, they are blown about with the wind and often find themselves lost far from their intended destination.
